title: Publish app live on sciquiztn-knowledgebyte domain

requirements.text: Publish the current released build live using the custom domain "sciquiztn-knowledgebyte" with no functional or UI changes as part of this request.
acceptanceCriteria: The live deployment uses the exact domain "sciquiztn-knowledgebyte" (letters/numbers/hyphens only).
The app loads successfully from the live URL without deployment errors.
No code changes are introduced as part of the publish-only action.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Use the exact domain string: sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.
nonGoals: Adding or modifying quiz features, UI, backend APIs, or data files.
Changing authentication, question sets, styling, or assets.
